title: Terminal and Machine Anew
author: Ada Zhou
blurb: Coral Okafor, a xenolinguist who can no longer dream in human languages, runs the long route between worlds that no longer speak. Then a distress signal arrives in a language extinct for two centuries — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must prove a massacre happened when every record says otherwise, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
